newsitem.title: USA: China Eastern Airlines files to sell 12.6 mln ADRs.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern Airlines files to sell 12.6 mln ADRs.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd said it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 12.6 million American Depositary Shares in an offering led by Morgan Stanley Asia Limited.
Of the 12.6 million shares, half will be offered in the U.S. and Canada and half in the Asia/Pacific region and Europe.
The company, based in China, said it expects the shares to sell at an initial offering price of between $16 and $18 per ADR. All of the shares are being sold by the company.
The company said it expects the ADRs to be listed on both the New York Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
The ADR offer represents 1.26 billion class H ordinary shares of the company. It is part of a worldwide offering of 1.4 billion class H ordinary shares, the company said.
The company provides passenger and airline cargo airline services.
